project.visitorDecision: Which source-backed pests are worth scouting in my selected Michigan crop and stage this season, and what action is justified?
project.primaryAction: Choose actual crop and growth stage, inspect the prioritized field sign and use the source to validate identification before intervention.

claims.subject: pest-model-reference
claims.limitation: MSU adult timing thresholds are reference only here; calculation-method parity and current input series not integrated, so the tool emits no emergence forecast.

claims.subject: pest-model-reference
claims.limitation: Model uses Jan 1 single triangle base 50/upper 92; current generic seasonal heat is not equivalent and must not be substituted.

claims.subject: biological-forecast
claims.limitation: Public specification lacks complete method details and programmatic rights; borer module remains qualitative seasonal scouting.

claims.subject: scouting-guidance
claims.limitation: Michigan extension scouting recommendations are season- and host-conditioned; not proof of any specific garden occurrence.

claims.subject: weather-context
claims.limitation: Only future official hourly NWS gridpoint weather is summarized; editorial wet/hot-dry cues are not validated pest probabilities and issue dates must be fresh.

claims.subject: invasive-state-detection
claims.limitation: No live county confirmation feed is connected. State guidance is linked; Bay County or home garden status is not inferred.

decisionState.selectedIdField: crop + stage + ZIP area + visitor-reported suspect
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: lib/garden-pest-watch.cjs makes deterministic stage/season IPM decisions; api/michigan-garden-pest-watch.js adds only quality-gated NWS context and Census ZCTA spatial semantics.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: When official NWS data, Census ZIP mapping or API are missing, no weather or emergence claim is made. A stable HTML scouting checklist remains available; invalid ZIP requires correction, never a silent city substitution.

scenarios.input: November 2; Bay City default; squash growing
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Prepare beds and retain non-invasive beneficial overwintering habitat; no claim of summer borer activity.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: SEASONAL_REFERENCE, not an adult-flight model or a nearby report.

scenarios.input: July; choose brassicas at seedling stage, ZIP 48706
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Prioritize cabbage maggot at soil line and flea beetle seedling checks; source links and ZIP interior-point meaning visible.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No active local adult claim; MSU biologic model is reference only.

scenarios.input: Switch squash → tomatoes → squash, and growing → flowering → growing
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The scouting answer, field notes and shareable URL restore the original crop/stage, with stale response ignored by request sequence.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No change to evidence type; local status remains unverified.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Readable default squash field assignment, original source link, and evergreen crop scouting tips remain in static HTML.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No live NWS indication, no misleading seasonal emergence date.

scenarios.input: Block all map tiles or image requests
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Tool continues unchanged; no map or external insect photo is a dependency.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Vector is decorative and explicitly not a species identification image.

scenarios.input: NWS issued >24h ago, timeseries empty or upstream throws
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Weather marked unavailable; crop/season decision still appears; no weather-derived pest assertion.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No stale forecast promoted into live presence or safe status.

scenarios.input: July squash, suspected squash vine borer visitor report
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Suspected borer is prioritized with signs and if-confirmed advice, but report clearly says not expert verified.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: GARDENER_REPORTED is distinct from REGION_REPORTED or confirmed.

failures.no-js: HTML default garden task, crop-specific evergreen tips and official source links remain visible.
failures.no-tiles: No map or tile dependency. All garden actions and links are text-first.
failures.no-image: No external insect photos are embedded pending provenance; decorative vector only, identified as not an ID image.
failures.stale-data: NWS issued time checked within 24h; local weather status UNAVAILABLE on stale/error and seasonal IPM remains.

qa.manualLayoutReview: Desktop and 390px full-page screenshot inspected in this build session; field-note layout and evidence lanes readable, no obstructing layers. Core content copy received a later host-crop fix requiring rerun.
failureCoverage: API source outage removes stale pest cards
Census ZCTA failure never silently replaces the location
Off-season crop-specific plan and user reported suspect

verified.note: Latest crop-specific science/data repairs require new CI.

deployed.note: Draft PR preview was READY; current updated head awaiting Vercel.

note: Exact current-head CI and Vercel must pass, and critical evidence gates must remain satisfied, before any merge. Missing numeric pest emergence models are deliberately excluded from the shipped feature, not represented as low risk. Outcome and quantitative event calibration require separate post-release evaluation.

overall.reason: Never treat source/crop unit-test passes as observed visitor task time or biological forecast calibration.
